Fields

All = 0

Finds all objects with this class and calls this method on all of them. Internally uses GameObject.FindObjectsByType.

Any = 1

Finds any object with this class and calls this method on it. Internally uses GameObject.FindAnyByType.

Argument = 3

The first argument of this command will be the instance to run this command on.

Note: You do not need to make the first argument of this method this class, but if you do it will be automatically filled in.

ArgumentArray = 4

The first argument of this command will be the array of instances to run this command on.

Note: You do not need to make the first argument of this method an array of this class, but if you do it will be automatically filled in.

First = 2

Finds the first object with this class and calls this method on it. Internally uses GameObject.FindFirstByType.
